Fighting in the sacred month answers aggression in the sacred month, and violations bring legal retribution, so answer an assault in kind while fearing Allah.
Fighting in the sacred month is a great sin, but averting people from Allah's way and from al-Masjid al-Haram and expelling its people are greater, and apostates' deeds become worthless.
Allah's register has twelve months, four of them sacred, in which not to wrong yourselves; fight the disbelievers collectively as they fight you, and postponing sacred months increases disbelief.
